log.headline: Stopped a laptop camera from auto-moving
log.detail: A teacher's video picture kept panning and zooming even though the video app's setting was off. The cause was a system-level camera effect on their laptop, which the app setting doesn't control, so I turned it off and they confirmed the fix.

log.headline: Swapped a damaged student Chromebook
log.detail: A student's Chromebook had a cracked screen and a broken hinge, so I issued a loaner while I kept their device for repair. When the loaner came back in good condition, I replaced it with a spare and closed out the ticket.

log.headline: Repaired a student's broken Chromebook
log.detail: I repaired the student's damaged Chromebook and returned it to them. Once the loaner came back in good condition, I closed out the swap.

log.headline: Restored a missing app on a staff Mac remotely
log.detail: A staff member's app search was broken after the disk filled up, so I rebuilt the search index remotely, which brought the app back within a minute. I also set up a copier queue for them and supported their move to the latest macOS.

log.headline: Set up a replacement MacBook Air for a teacher
log.detail: I enrolled a new MacBook Air in our device management system and moved the teacher's files over from their old laptop. The swap was completed on October 29, 2026.

log.headline: Responded to a low black toner alert
log.detail: The print management system flagged two shared printers with black toner down to 2%, and I handled the alert. Resolution details weren't recorded in the ticket.

log.headline: Unblocked a rhyming website for a music class
log.detail: A teacher asked for a rhyming dictionary site to be unblocked so students could use it for songwriting, and I reviewed the request and allowed access.

log.headline: Swapped a student's broken Chromebook hinge
log.detail: A student's Chromebook had a hinge that was coming fully off, so I issued a loaner while it was with IT. When the loaner came back in good condition, I gave the student a spare device to keep.
